name: shared-memory
description: Memco Shared Memory gives your AI agents a persistent, shared memory. Search before you work; persist what you learn.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent shared memory for your team's agents
interface.longDescription: Memco Shared Memory gives your team a shared, persistent memory. Agents search it for proven solutions, design rationale, and gotchas before starting work, and persist what they learn afterwards — so when one agent discovers a solution, all agents know.
